titulo: QUARENTA E OITO HORAS PARA CASAR
personagens: Aline, a bride around 31 with long wavy dark hair and an unfinished wedding dress; the groom, a man around 33 with a trimmed beard and glasses; a seamstress around 65 with a measuring tape around her neck; friendly neighbors
cenario: a seamstress workshop and a charming neighborhood library with tall bookshelves
cenas: Aline on the phone in panic, the wedding venue canceled two days before the ceremony
Aline at the seamstress workshop during a dress fitting, worried
The seamstress handing Aline a box of photos and suggesting the library
Aline arriving at a closed library and finding neighbors measuring tables and a teacher testing lights
Aline standing among bookshelves, moved, a folded banner on a pile of books
Memory scene of Aline and the groom meeting at a book club circle in the same library
Neighbors carefully rearranging tables between bookshelves, respecting the books
Aline and the groom setting up a small intimate ceremony with fairy lights in the library
During the vows, the groom placing the first book they discussed on the table
The small wedding celebration in the library, guests toasting, warm golden light
